notes:
v1.0.83 - Duplicate-aware installs + Mods version menu matches Modpacks + fixed instance overflow menu:
1) ALREADY-INSTALLED DETECTION + SAFE DUPLICATES: browsing a mod that is already installed in your
   instance shows a disabled Installed button. Hold Shift to re-arm it (Install Duplicate) and click
   to confirm - the copy installs with its own unique filename (Name (duplicate).jar), never
   overwriting the original, and Remove/Update act on exactly one copy. Works in the per-instance
   Mods page AND in the Games > Mods instance picker (Installed badge + Shift + confirmation).
2) VERSION MENU: the Mods browser Minecraft version filter now matches the Modpacks section
   (searchable dropdown with pinned Any Minecraft version).
3) INSTANCE OVERFLOW MENU FIXED: the Open Folder / Repair Fabric / Duplicate / Delete menu now
   renders as the proper dark styled dropdown anchored under the button (was unstyled boxes).
4) Worlds keep working from your instances: browse worlds, infinite scroll, search, install into
   saves/ of any instance you pick.
